title: Tracking anonymous players through parsed replays
body: If I am not mistaken replays contain the account ids of all players, regardless of their match data sharing preference. Therefore, it's possible to collect to fill in those accounts in the match data from the WebAPI. What do you think?
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: It is possible, but we intentionally don't do this because Valve probably wouldn't approve.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
